children: an offering of ~$4.9B equivalent senior notes.

The offering comprises five tranches, including €1B of 4.25% senior notes due 2033, €500M of 4.625% notes due 2036, $1B of 5.5% notes due 2034, $1B of 5.75% notes due 2037 and $1.2B of 5.25% notes due 2032.
expects to use the proceeds, along with cash on hand, to fund debt redemptions, related expenses and other corporate purposes.
The company plans to redeem several existing notes, including 6.75% notes due 2028, 7.875% and 7.375% sustainability-linked notes due 2029, and portions of notes due 2027 and 2030.
also expects to redeem all of its 8.125% sustainability-linked notes due 2031.
The settlement of the new notes is expected on or around September 16.

title: Teva prices $4.9B senior notes to refinance higher-cost debt
